title: 第15章 阿爹被骗啦！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
面对宁芊芊的呼喊，楚星尘停下了脚步。

    微微侧首，目光看向神色纠结的宁芊芊。

    面前的宁芊芊虽然叫住了自己，但警惕心可能并没有减弱。

    适当拿捏一下，才能更好的让她说出真实的情况。

    “怎么了？”楚星尘询问一声，随后转身，目光平静的望向宁芊芊。

    宁芊芊面露纠结，随后还是小心翼翼的询问：

    “大仙，你是哪一家宗门的？”

    楚星尘毫不犹豫的开口：“中洲，万法仙门。”

    对于撒谎楚星尘没有任何的不好意思，毕竟面前的少女也从未对自己讲过什么实话不是？

    欺骗都是相互的。

    尤其是面前瘦弱的少女的底细还未清楚，更何况，天道盟的宗门名字实在太过伟岸，也怕面前的少女听了之后太过害怕。

    宁芊芊露出一副久仰大名的神情。

    但其实宁芊芊作为凡人，从未踏入过修仙世界，哪里知道什么中州不中州。

    这方世界说无边无际来形容也有些夸张，但已经非常之大。

    就连边陲小国也疆域万里。

    南部瞻洲也已是大界，清风宗在偏僻之地，但在此处也是鼎鼎大名。

    至于南部瞻洲的灵脉汇聚之地，更是宗门众多。

    中州对于这里来说其实已是犹如隔天一般。

    要不是宁芊芊的阿爹交代要去的是清风宗，宁芊芊作为山野农夫之家，也不会知道清风宗的名称。

    宁芊芊这么问，纯属是想隐晦告知面前的面具男，自己并非看上去的那么一无所知。

    不要试图糊弄自己，虽然可能并没有什么用，但总比不做强不是？

    不过……中州，听阿爹说过，是传说中的修仙圣地。

    更何况，万法仙门这个宗门名字，听起来实在是有那么点好厉害的感觉。

    万法仙门呐！

    再听听清风宗！

    谁强谁弱一听不就很是明显？

    更何况万法仙门一听就更像名门正派。

    不过听说跟这种名门正派打交道，得先学会卖惨。

    博得这种大仙的同情，人家才会觉得自己可怜然后才伸出援手。
content_en:
Facing Ning Qianqian's shout, Chu Xingchen stopped.

    He tilted his head slightly and looked at Ning Qianqian, who looked troubled.

    Although Ning Qianqian in front of her stopped her, her vigilance may not have weakened.

    Only by controlling it appropriately can she better tell the true situation.

    "What's wrong?" Chu Xingchen asked, then turned around and looked at Ning Qianqian calmly.

    Ning Qianqian looked confused, but then asked cautiously:

    "Great Immortal, which sect are you from?"

    Chu Xingchen said without hesitation: "Zhongzhou, Wanfa Immortal Sect."

    Chu Xingchen didn't have any embarrassment about lying. After all, the girl in front of him had never told the truth to him, right?

    The deception is all mutual.

    Especially since the details of the thin girl in front of him are not clear yet. What's more, the name of the Tiandao Alliance's sect is too majestic, and he is afraid that the girl in front of him will be too scared after hearing it.

    Ning Qianqian showed an expression of admiration for the famous name for a long time.

    But in fact, as a mortal, Ning Qianqian has never stepped into the world of immortal cultivation, so she doesn't know what Zhongzhou is.

    It would be an exaggeration to say that this world is boundless, but it is already very big.

    Even small border countries cover thousands of miles.

    Zhanzhou in the south is also a big world. Qingfeng Sect is in a remote place, but it is also famous here.

    As for the place where spiritual veins gather in Zhanzhou in the south, there are even more sects.

    Zhongzhou is actually like another day to this place.

    If Ning Qianqian's father hadn't told him that he was going to the Qingfeng Sect, Ning Qianqian, as a farmer in the mountains, would not have known the name of the Qingfeng Sect.

    Ning Qianqian asked this simply because she wanted to tell the masked man in front of her in a subtle way that she was not as clueless as she seemed.

    Don't try to fool yourself. Although it may not be of any use, it is better than nothing, right?

    But... Zhongzhou, I heard from my father, is the legendary holy land for cultivating immortals.

    What's more, the name of the sect, Wanfa Xianmen, sounds really powerful.

    Wanfa Immortal Sect!

    Listen to Qingfeng Sect again!

    Isn’t it obvious who is stronger and who is weaker?

    What's more, the Wanfa Immortal Sect sounds more like a famous and upright sect.

    But I heard that to deal with such a distinguished family, you must first learn to be miserable.

    Only by winning the sympathy of such a great being will people feel pity for themselves and then lend a helping hand.
